overview: The City Council approved several labor and personnel ordinances, including a wage floor for contracted services and salary adjustments for department heads. The body also debated the fiscal year 2027 budget, ultimately tabling it pending more information on legal spending.

items.title: Approval of meeting records
items.summary: Approved meeting records from May and June 2026, including a spelling correction to the June 3rd records.

items.title: 25189: Standard Compensation Ordinance
items.summary: Approved the third reading of an ordinance establishing a wage floor and fair benefits for contracted janitorial and security services despite an administrative request for further delay. Amendments were adopted to clarify definitions and enforcement authorities.

items.title: 26084: Personnel Ordinance salary classifications
items.summary: Approved salary classification increases for the Directors of Diversity, Veterans Services, and Elections to align the three positions within the same compensation tier. Councilors rejected an administrative proposal to place the Elections Manager at a lower tier, citing the results of a formal classification study.

items.title: 26108: Grant of Location, National Grid
items.summary: Approved a grant of location for National Grid to install four-inch underground electrical conduit at Mystic Valley Parkway subject to engineering division conditions.

items.title: 26109: Coldstone Creamery extended hours
items.summary: Approved extended summer operating hours until 1:00 AM daily for Coldstone Creamery, subject to a 21-day review period to monitor for neighborhood impacts.

items.title: 26110: MBTA bus network redesign resolution
items.summary: Approved a resolution to inform residents and solicit feedback regarding the MBTA’s proposed bus network redesign affecting routes 80, 94, and 96.

items.title: 26111: Affordable Housing Trust Fund Board appointment
items.summary: Approved the reappointment of Lisa Ann Davidson to the Affordable Housing Trust Fund Board.

items.title: 26112: Food truck permits
items.summary: Approved a food truck permit for June 13th but tabled remaining summer dates to allow for further consultation with local brick-and-mortar businesses.

items.title: 26113: Water and Sewer Enterprise Fund appropriation
items.summary: Approved the appropriation of $5.5 million from water and sewer retained earnings for water main replacement projects on several city streets.

items.title: 26114: School Department override stabilization appropriation
items.summary: Approved an appropriation of approximately $1.08 million from the override stabilization fund to support Medford Public Schools programming and teacher contract costs.

items.title: 26115: Establishment of PEG access special revenue fund
items.summary: Accepted state law to establish a public, educational, and governmental access special revenue fund to manage cable franchise fees for fiscal year 2027.

items.title: 26061: Fiscal Year 2027 Budget submission
items.summary: Tabled the fiscal year 2027 general fund and enterprise budgets until June 23rd following discussion regarding law department spending and requests for information concerning legal service line items.

items.title: 26105: Affordable Housing Trust free cash
items.summary: Tabled a request for an appropriation of free cash for the Affordable Housing Trust Fund.
